title: Green Account (savings): How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
summary: This document explains that the Green Account (savings) earns interest based on your daily balance, compounded daily, with an APY set at 4.0%. Accrued interest is credited monthly, and it provides tips to maintain a consistent balance and eligibility for the 4.0% APY.
